rationale: FX01 asserts that these debt rows are non-USD source par rows lacking explicit USD conversion. The raw SOI does not show non-USD par: it labels the debt schedule with a Par Amount column, shows dollar signs on the first debt line's par/cost/fair-value cells, and subsequent debt lines continue in the same columns with omitted repeated symbols. The check appears to have treated blank repeated currency-symbol cells as non-USD, so the FX01 flag is not a real source-backed data error.
